1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

* **[Epstein-Barr virus reactivation precedes multiple sclerosis attacks](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04665-3)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Increased expression of Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) reactivation genes in B cells precedes clinical MS attacks.
  * The EBV viral transactivator protein EBNA-2 was found to directly target host MS risk genes, establishing a mechanistic bridge between viral reactivation and disease exacerbation.

* **[Exosome-based liquid biopsy demonstrates high accuracy for early pancreatic cancer](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04625-x)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A prospective multi-center study in 1,785 individuals evaluated the PANXEON exosome-based biomarker panel combined with carbohydrate antigen 19-9 (CA 19-9) levels.
  * The combined assay achieved high sensitivity for detecting early-stage pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) across international validation cohorts.

* **[Compact transcriptomic programs predict treatment-specific responses in lupus nephritis](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.13.26362948)** — *medRxiv*
  * Machine learning analysis of gene-expression profiles from 319 lupus nephritis patients (GSE224705) identified compact 5-to-10-gene programs predictive of individual patient response.
  * Predictive accuracy was strongly regimen-specific across mycophenolate mofetil (MMF), azathioprine (AZA), hydroxychloroquine (HC), and standard-of-care arms.

* **[Mendelian randomization identifies 11 plasma protein biomarkers for early-onset stroke](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.14.26363028)** — *medRxiv*
  * A two-sample proteome-wide Mendelian randomization study integrating UK Biobank plasma proteomics (n = 54,219) and Early-Onset Stroke Consortium data (11,114 cases aged <60 years) identified 11 causal protein biomarkers.
  * Causal associations were mapped across distinct ischemic stroke etiologic subtypes according to TOAST criteria.

* **[Spatial transcriptomics delineates distinct fibrotic and muscularizing niches in Crohn’s disease](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.14.26363080)** — *medRxiv*
  * Layer-resolved NanoString GeoMx whole-transcriptome profiling across full-thickness intestinal wall sections from patients with fibrostenotic Crohn’s disease revealed distinct molecular programs in stenotic versus non-stenotic segments.
  * Results separated extracellular matrix fibrotic remodeling in the submucosa from smooth-muscle hypertrophy in the muscularis mucosae and propria.

* **[Protective APOL1 M1 modifier variant acts exclusively within the KIK protein haplotype](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.14.26362999)** — *medRxiv*
  * Phased haplotype analysis in over 113,000 participants confirmed that the kidney-protective APOL1 p.N264K (M1) variant occurs strictly on the KIK (p.Lys150/p.Ile228/p.Lys255) background.
  * Functional assays demonstrated that M1 requires this specific haplotype context to block APOL1 cation channel flux when co-inherited in cis with the G2 risk allele.

* **[Multi-omic profiling reveals sex-dimorphic biological aging trajectories across organ systems](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04662-6)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Organ-specific and omics-based biological aging clocks demonstrated that male and female tissue aging dynamics diverge significantly.
  * The findings establish distinct organ-specific aging rates between sexes that correlate with differential disease risk trajectories.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

* **[Biotech] [GFH375 demonstrates clinical activity in KRAS G12D-mutated solid tumors](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04559-4)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * Phase 1 data evaluating GFH375, an oral dual on-off state KRAS G12D inhibitor, showed encouraging objective response rates in pretreated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and pancreatic cancer.
  * The safety profile was predominantly characterized by low-grade treatment-related adverse events, alongside one reported treatment-related death.

* **[AAV Factor IX Padua gene therapy reduces bleeding in adolescent hemophilia B](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04636-8)** — *Nature Medicine*
  * A single-arm Phase 1 trial evaluating an adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapy encoding the high-activity Factor IX Padua variant in 11 adolescents with hemophilia B met its primary safety endpoint.
  * Treated patients demonstrated sustained Factor IX activity and significant reductions in annualized bleeding rates.

* **[Targeted memory reactivation during sleep augments PTSD psychotherapy in Phase 2 trial](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.14.26362979)** — *medRxiv*
  * A randomized clinical trial tested olfactory cueing during sleep concurrent with a 12-week trauma-focused psychotherapy protocol in patients with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
  * Re-exposure to therapy-associated odor during sleep boosted slow-wave EEG activity and reduced emotional arousal during traumatic memory recall, enhancing clinical symptom reduction.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

* **[Big Pharma] [AstraZeneca highlights ADC efficacy advancements in small cell lung cancer at WCLC 2026](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/wclc-2026-adc-b7h3-china-study-results-astrazeneca/830247/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Clinical trial presentations at the World Conference on Lung Cancer highlighted Phase 2/3 data for targeted antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), including B7-H3-directed constructs, in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (SCLC).
  * Trial results demonstrated improved overall survival compared to historical standard-of-care chemo-immunotherapy regimens in difficult-to-treat SCLC populations.

* **[Biotech] [Coya Therapeutics reaches enrollment milestone in Phase 2/3 ALS trial](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099831820963512482)** — *BioStocks*
  * Coya Therapeutics enrolled its 100th participant in the Phase 2/3 ALSTARS trial evaluating COYA 302 for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).
  * Topline data from the trial are anticipated in early Q2 based on current screening and enrollment rates.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

* **[FDA opens applications for Expedited IND Pilot under Operation Trialblazer](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-launches-expedited-ind-pilot-begins-accepting-applications)** — *FDA*
  * The FDA launched the Expedited Investigational New Drug (IND) Pilot Program under HHS Operation Trialblazer, accepting sponsor applications through October 30, 2026.
  * The pilot partners drug sponsors with designated Qualified Research Institutions (QRIs) for rolling pre-IND reviews to shorten first-in-human clinical trial startup times in the U.S.

* **[Biotech] [Curium gains FDA approval for Bexlutry, the first generic radioligand therapy](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/radioligand-generic-sionna-layoffs-novo-contineum-arrowhead-corbus/830246/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * The FDA approved Curium’s Bexlutry (lutetium Lu 177 dotatate), marking the first approved generic radiopharmaceutical for cancer.
  * Indicated for somatostatin receptor (SSTR)-positive gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, the approval follows Curium's successful resolution of patent litigation with Novartis (maker of Lutathera).

* **[FDA adds boxed warnings to Kybella label against off-label body contouring](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-communications/fda-approves-additional-information-labeling-kybella-deoxycholic-acid-injection-warning-adverse)** — *FDA*
  * The FDA approved revised prescribing information for Kybella (deoxycholic acid) to explicitly warn against injection outside the submental fat region.
  * Adverse event reporting confirmed risks of severe neuromuscular injuries, injection-site ulceration, and tissue necrosis when used in unapproved body sites.

* **[Biotech] [Vera Therapeutics prepares kidney filing; obesity developers expand trials to young children](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/15/biotech-news-obesity-drugmakers-are-testing-in-kids-as-young-as-si/)** — *STAT*
  * Vera Therapeutics is finalizing its regulatory submission package for its lead kidney disease candidate.
  * Concurrently, clinical trial protocols for metabolic and obesity therapeutics are expanding enrollment down to pediatric patients as young as 6 years old.

* **[FDA issues health fraud alerts for illicit active ingredients in OTC supplements](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/medication-health-fraud-notifications/sexual-enhancement-and-energy-product-notifications)** — *FDA*
  * FDA laboratory testing confirmed unlisted prescription active pharmaceutical ingredients—including sibutramine and amino-tadalafil—in over-the-counter products including DEEP, Beauty 911, and LUZE Fit Intensity.

* **[Biotech] [FDA accepts Cogent's NDA for bezuclastinib in advanced systemic mastocytosis](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099831326593462527)** — *BioStocks*
  * The FDA accepted Cogent Biosciences' New Drug Application (NDA) for bezuclastinib to treat patients with advanced systemic mastocytosis (AdvSM).
  * The agency indicated it has no current plans to hold an advisory committee meeting and identified no potential review issues, setting a PDUFA date of June 29, 2027.

* **[Biotech] [Ocular Therapeutix plans Q4 NDA submission for AXPAXLI in wet AMD](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2099830629537890396)** — *BioStocks*
  * Ocular Therapeutix remains on track to submit an NDA for AXPAXLI in wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD) in Q4.
  * The planned submission will be supported by Week 52 efficacy and safety data from the SOL-1 trial, interim safety data from SOL-R, and confirmatory evidence.

5. **Business & Strategy**

* **[Big Pharma] [GSK licenses global rights for clinical-stage Chinese multiple myeloma asset](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/15/gsk-china-drug-licensing-deal-job-losses/)** — *STAT*
  * GSK secured exclusive global rights to a clinical-stage multiple myeloma therapeutic originally developed by a Chinese biopharmaceutical company to expand its targeted hematology pipeline.

* **[Biotech] [Sionna Therapeutics cuts 50% of staff following cystic fibrosis clinical failure](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/radioligand-generic-sionna-layoffs-novo-contineum-arrowhead-corbus/830246/)** — *BioPharma Dive*
  * Sionna Therapeutics is laying off nearly half of its workforce and restructuring its clinical development programs.
  * The cost-reduction strategy follows disappointing top-line phase readout results for its lead cystic fibrosis drug candidate.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

* **[UK real-world study confirms effectiveness of 2025 bi-annual COVID-19 boosters](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.14.26362989)** — *medRxiv*
  * Test-negative case-control analyses in England evaluated the 2025 vaccination campaigns in adults aged ≥75 years and immunosuppressed individuals.
  * Results demonstrated robust protection against COVID-19 hospitalization for both spring JN.1-based and autumn KP.2-based booster formulations.

* **[Pennsylvania reports fourth fatal pediatric measles case linked to ADEM](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/15/fourth-measles-death-pennsylvania-acute-disseminated-encephalomyelitis/)** — *STAT*
  * Public health authorities in Pennsylvania confirmed a fourth measles-associated death during an ongoing regional outbreak, occurring in an unvaccinated 18-year-old due to acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM).

* **[WHO pediatric surveillance highlights heavy Shigella burden in LMICs](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.14.26363009)** — *medRxiv*
  * Data from 70,750 hospitalized children under age 5 across 31 low- and middle-income countries in the GPDS network (2017–2022) defined high strain-specific attributable fractions for *Shigella flexneri* and *Shigella sonnei*, reinforcing targets for ongoing vaccine development.

* **[House Democrats outline post-midterm healthcare oversight priorities](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/16/healthcare-reform-house-democrats-oversight-targets-after-midterms/)** — *STAT*
  * Congressional leadership is preparing legislative oversight strategies targeting PBM practices, commercial prior-authorization policies, and Medicare tech-enabled chronic care pilots.

**Worth watching:** FDA's Expedited IND Pilot Program could shift early-stage oncology and rare disease trial launches back to U.S. academic centers if sponsors utilize rolling reviews to match first-in-human timelines currently seen in Australia and China, alongside Ocular Therapeutix's anticipated Q4 NDA filing for AXPAXLI in wet AMD and Coya Therapeutics' early Q2 Phase 2/3 ALSTARS readout in ALS.
